name: December 15, 2025 Regular Meeting - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting

Please take notice that the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of Monday, December 15,
2025, is hereby adjourned to Tuesday, December 16, 2025 at 6:30 p.m.

The Adjourned Regular meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at City Hall, 23825 Stuart
Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please contact the Planning Commission at
PlanningCommission@malibucity.org, or (310) 456-2489 ext. 246.

Dated: December 5, 2025 at 6:11 p.m.

_______________________________________
Rebecca Evans, Senior Management Analyst
